goal: An autonomous trading research factory that continuously converts raw ideas into scored evidence across crypto, forex, and prediction markets.

plan.title: EMA Trend Gate on BNBUSDT — Cross-Asset Generalization Validation
plan.objective: Validate EMA Trend Gate strategy (4h EMA regime filter + 1h RSI pullback entries) on BNBUSDT to test cross-asset generalization. Strategy validated on BTC (0.998 Sharpe), ETH (0.489 Sharpe), SOL (1.373 Sharpe). BNB represents exchange token with unique utility-driven demand patterns.
plan.hypothesis: BNB's exchange token characteristics will produce different volatility regimes than pure cryptocurrencies (BTC/ETH) or Solana, but the multi-timeframe regime filter should provide positive expectancy similar to other assets tested.
plan.strategy_rationale: Strategy already validated on BTC, ETH, and SOL with consistent positive Sharpe. This run tests whether the EMA trend gate generalizes to Binance's native token which has unique demand drivers (trading fee discounts, Binance Smart Chain utility). Using identical param grid ensures comparable results.
dataset_requirements: 1h OHLCV candles for BNB/USDT from Binance
Minimum 2 years history per market policy
Must include volume data for validation

historical_depth_requirement.justification: BNB data available from April 2021. Multi-year history required per market policy for crypto. Current dataset provides ~43,789 1h bars, exceeding 2-year minimum.

source_plan.selection_reason: Existing BNB/USDT 1h deep data already available in workspace/data/binance_bnbusdt_1h_deep.csv with 43,789 rows from 2021-04-02. No fetch required.

plan.scope_selection_rationale: BNB is the 3rd largest Binance spot asset by volume (after BTC/ETH). Represents distinct market character as exchange token vs pure crypto. Testing generalization across different asset classes (exchange token vs Proof-of-Work vs L1 blockchain) strengthens evidence on strategy robustness.

data_acquisition.reason: Data already present at workspace/data/binance_bnbusdt_1h_deep.csv with 43,789 rows spanning 2021-04-02 to present. Sufficient for multi-year WFA.

implementation_steps: 1. Update wfa_config.yaml to point to binance_bnbusdt_1h_deep.csv
2. Run WFA with same param grid as BTC/ETH/SOL experiments
3. Collect OOS Sharpe, drawdown, trade count, win rate metrics
4. Compare cross-asset results against BTC (0.998 Sharpe), ETH (0.489 Sharpe), SOL (1.373 Sharpe)

evaluation_criteria.status_gate: WFA completes with valid OOS Sharpe; trade count >= 30

fallback_if_blocked: If BNB data insufficient, fall back to fetching fresh data via Binance API
If WFA fails, use minimal backtest for preliminary signal validation
notes: BNB is exchange token with unique utility demand patterns - different from pure crypto assets
Results will be compared against BTC (0.998), ETH (0.489), SOL (1.373) for cross-asset generalization evidence
Same param grid as prior runs ensures comparable results for valid generalization test
